source_title: Why Market Leaders Are Staying on Top Longer in 2026
underlying_data_period: 1990-2025 public market valuations; 2015-2025 value creation; end-2025 comparison
business_context: Is incumbent leadership stable AND capturing new value?
key_message: Incumbent longevity does not guarantee value creation: compare top-five leadership tenure and share of new industry value captured together.

data_spec.sample: 14 visually legible sectors of 15 study groups
data_spec.numerator_y: top-five incumbents with tenure > industry median

data_recipe: choose consistent industry membership and market capitalization
compute new value captured over prior 10 years
plot x and y; validate points
diff_notes: Original figure was viewed but coordinates digitized ±4 pp; partial label overlap and editorial quadrant boundaries; exact fidelity not verified.

training_pair.instruction: Build a config-driven 2D consulting scatter comparing new value capture and leadership tenure.
training_pair.response: Use the bundled chart.py render(data,theme,context)->fig; supply rows of bundled data.csv with industry,value_capture_pct,tenure_pct,uncertainty_pp,provenance and bundled config.json THEME.source/neutral and CONTEXT. Run: python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png. Values are approximate digitized_estimate; do not use as exact reported coordinates.
